payout_quote: Official AmazingTalker (en.amazingtalker.com): 'most English pronunciation teachers charge US$15–28 per 50 minute private lesson, and US$6–10 per 25 minute trial lesson.' And: 'All tutors with AmazingTalker are paid on a monthly basis.' 'Once a lesson is successfully completed, your tutoring fees will be accrued to your income balance. Payments are made on the 2nd of every month.' 'A variable service fee will be charged based on the hourly rate you set... the more teaching hours you complete each month, the lower your service fee rate will be, with rates as low as 0%.'
steps: Apply as an AmazingTalker tutor for your subject/language.
Set your lesson prices (AmazingTalker publishes typical $15–$28 per 50-min lesson as guidance).
Teach completed lessons; fees accrue to your income balance.
Paid monthly on the 2nd via PayPal, TransferWise, or Payoneer, minus a variable service fee.
catches: A variable service fee is charged based on your hourly rate — your take-home is below your listed price; the fee rate falls toward 0% as you teach more hours.
The $15–$28 per 50-minute lesson is what teachers CHARGE (typical), not guaranteed take-home.
Monthly payout on the 2nd — earnings accrue and are not instant.
You must prepare your own teaching materials; cancellations need 12+ hours' notice.
biggest_catch: The typical $15–$28 per 50-minute lesson is a charged price, not take-home — a variable service fee (declining with volume, as low as 0%) is deducted, and you only get paid monthly on the 2nd after completed lessons.
eligibility: Subject/language teaching ability; approved tutor application.
timing: Monthly payment on the 2nd via PayPal/TransferWise/Payoneer.
